title: An invoice with exact money
description:
Build an invoice that adds up to the penny, with tax per line and a correct rounding policy.

```
2 x Keyboard @ 49.99   net 99.98   VAT 20%  20.00
3 x Cable    @  4.33   net 12.99   VAT 20%   2.60
1 x Book     @ 12.00   net 12.00   VAT  0%   0.00
net 124.97  VAT 22.60  total 147.57
```
requirements: `BigDecimal` everywhere, created from strings; tax rounded per line with `HALF_UP`.
Discounts as percentages and as fixed amounts, never making a line negative.
Totals checked: the sum of the lines equals the invoice total exactly (`compareTo`).
stretch: Print the invoice for a chosen `Locale` with `NumberFormat.getCurrencyInstance`.
